content: Bubbletea terminal cleanup and signal handling pitfalls: (1) Panic inside a tea.Cmd goroutine does NOT trigger CatchPanics recovery — terminal is left in raw mode with hidden cursor; CatchPanics only covers the event loop itself. (2) SIGTERM historically was not caught by bubbletea — terminal left unusable when killed with timeout or kill; patched in PR #412. (3) Multiple bubbletea programs run in succession each install signal handlers without cleaning up — n-th program requires n-1 extra Ctrl+C presses. (4) Always check the error return from p.Run() — do not use _, _ = p.Run(). (5) Goroutine leak in tea.Cmd that blocks on channel can prevent clean exit. (6) tea.Kill() skips final render but restores terminal — useful for crash recovery paths.
